description: Defines an object 'DeviceNames' with a function 'bestDefaultNodeName' that determines a suitable device name for Android devices based on available settings and device model.

classes.name: DeviceNames
classes.description: An object providing device name utilities.

methods.name: bestDefaultNodeName
methods.description: Returns the best default node name for the device, attempting to retrieve a user-defined name, falling back to manufacturer and model, or defaulting to 'Android Node'.
